common_mistakes.consequence: Isp falls back to the continuous floor and RESCUE remains unlatched, so Pac’s entry stays closed.
common_mistakes.recovery: Keep or return Pac to BUBBLES, let the already-started attack cycle again, and reposition Isp for another float; this is source-supported recovery, not a dedicated current-room recovery replay.
